about: C2b critic copy of guns_idle with the turn counter read at the end

steps.name: the title, BEGIN at the test bed
every contest, the controls let go

steps.check: D.lost === 6 && D.won === 0 && D.allWarned && D.falls.every((w) => w && w !== 'timeout')
steps.label: doing nothing loses every contest, each with a warning and a reason

steps.eval: (() => { const S = G.guns.spin; return S ? { secDeg: Math.round(S.sec * 57.3), revDeg: Math.round(S.rev * 57.3), turnDeg: Math.round(S.turn * 57.3), who: S.who, whoTurn: S.whoTurn } : null; })()
